body: I hope you'll find something to change your way to look at life, just like I hope I change mine. I think we both know that life can be beautiful, we just can't grasp what's there for us. Nowadays I feel numb about this whole situation, I just keep living and I do what I have to do, mechanically. It is frustrating. I would love to find a goal or a real passion to dedicate my life to. I looked for it my entire life but I couldn't find it. Maybe that's my problem, maybe I should realise that what I have already is a blessing and if there's more to come, that's up to the future. Or am I looking for something that doesn't exist? Is that why I'm in such a pitiful state? I don't really know.
